answer: The subdomain '7.6 Multi-agent risks' refers to risks specific to AI systems that autonomously plan, invoke external tools, execute multi-step action chains, and interact with other agents or environments with reduced human involvement. It includes sub-groups such as Autonomous Actions and Tool Use (which involves autonomous decisions and real-world actions) and Multi-agent Integrity (which deals with emergent behavior, coordination failure, and conflicting objectives among agents).
